newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: China trade minister mobbed by Taiwan TV at APEC.
newsitem.headline: China trade minister mobbed by Taiwan TV at APEC.

text.p: China's diminutive Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation Wu Yi was mobbed by Taiwanese television reporters on Thursday after meeting her U.S. counterpart Charlene Barshefsky.

Both women had to fight through a noisy encirclement of reporters that gave added meaning to the word press after their hour-long meeting on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) conference.
Taiwanese reporters, eager to grab a rare chance to meet a mainland minister, peppered Wu with questions about Taiwan's possible accession to the World Trade Organisation (WTO).
"If you do like this, I can't go on," she cried as the heaving circle of bodies, very much resembling a rugby scrum, squeezed down a corridor.
